feature: iPhone and iPad summary AI capability and explicit routing

scenarios.name: Refuse an unavailable Apple summary choice without silently routing elsewhere
scenarios.given: Apple Intelligence is unavailable and the user has an explicit summary provider and server choice
scenarios.when: the user tries to select Apple Intelligence
scenarios.then: Apple is not offered as an enabled action, attempted selection is refused with the runtime recovery reason, and previous provider, server and model choices remain unchanged; no cloud service is selected

scenarios.name: Preserve a saved unavailable Apple choice with clear recovery
scenarios.given: a previously saved Apple summary provider is unavailable on the current device
scenarios.when: its availability or client is requested
scenarios.then: the runtime recovery reason blocks use while preserving the saved choice and requiring an explicit alternate provider selection

scenarios.name: Refresh summary eligibility when returning to the foreground
scenarios.given: Apple Intelligence readiness changes while the app is away
scenarios.when: the app returns to the foreground or settings refresh availability
scenarios.then: the current reason and selectable choice update without automatically selecting another provider or requiring summary AI for microphone capture
